title: Return Policy - Furniture, Opened
text:
This policy covers opened chairs and desks bought from our store, whether you ordered online or bought in person. Opened furniture, including pieces you have already put together, can be sent back within 180 days of the day you received it, with your proof of purchase, for a full refund. The time limit counts from the day the furniture reached you, or from the day it was delivered to your home.

What to send back

Opened furniture must come back with every part, screw, bracket and tool that came with it, and with the assembly guide if you still have it. Pieces that belong to a set must come back as a complete set, so a desk with a matching drawer unit, or a pair of chairs sold together, goes back together. Protect corners and legs with the original packing material or with blankets, so that nothing is scratched or dented on the way. Chairs and desks that have been damaged, stained, cut or painted cannot be accepted. Take a photo of each piece before it leaves your home, so that any damage on the way can be traced.

How to start a return

To start a return for opened furniture, sign in to your account, go to your order history and choose the pieces you want to send back, or bring your proof of purchase to the returns desk in one of our stores. Large pieces are collected from your home: once you start the return, we contact you to arrange a pickup time, and the driver checks each piece before taking it away. Smaller pieces, such as a single chair, can be brought to the returns desk, where a team member checks them with you. If a desk will not fit through the door in one piece, the driver can take it apart before carrying it out.

Your refund

Once the opened furniture has been checked, we send the refund to the payment method you used. It normally shows in your account within a few business days, depending on your bank. Gift card payments are refunded to a gift card, and a payment split across several methods is refunded in the same split. Delivery and assembly services are not refunded, because the work has already been done. If you paid in a store, you can also ask for the refund at the returns desk in the same way you paid.

Pieces we cannot take back

Floor samples and made-to-order pieces, such as a desk top cut to a custom length, cannot be sent back, even when they are opened. Furniture that was used outdoors, or stored in a damp room such as a basement or a bathroom, is not accepted either, because moisture can damage the wood and the fittings in ways that cannot be repaired.

Exchanges

You can exchange furniture for another colour or size within the same time limit. The exchange follows the same steps as a return, and the replacement is delivered or held for pickup once the original piece has been checked. If the replacement costs more you pay the difference, and if it costs less we refund the difference. Where the piece you want is not available, we tell you straight away and you can choose a refund instead. A replacement for opened furniture in another colour must come from the same range, so that matching pieces stay matched.
